title: Analytical Exposition Text
summary: Analytical exposition tingkat lanjut: struktur tesis–argumen–reiteration, membangun argumen dengan klaim, alasan, bukti, konsesi, dan sanggahan, serta menilai kekuatan argumen pada teks bertopik teknologi dan isu faktual.

blocks.html:
Analytical exposition berusaha meyakinkan pembaca bahwa suatu pendapat benar atau suatu fenomena penting. Pada tingkat lanjut, argumennya lebih padat: setiap alasan biasanya didukung bukti dan penulis sering menjawab keberatan.

BagianIsiContoh penanda
Thesisposisi penulis, sering didahului latar belakang isuI believe, Far from being ..., ... should
Argumentsalasan + penjelasan + buktiTo begin with, In addition, Most importantly
Counterargument + rebuttalkeberatan pihak lain lalu sanggahan (sering di paragraf terakhir sebelum simpulan)Critics are right that ..., However; It is true that ... Nevertheless
Reiterationpenegasan kembali tesisTherefore, In short, What is needed now is ...

blocks.title: Jenis bukti
blocks.html:
• Statistik/data: angka dari survei atau penelitian.
  • Pendapat ahli atau lembaga: according to the WHO.
  • Contoh: kasus nyata, misalnya kebijakan di negara lain.
  • Anekdot: pengalaman pribadi. Paling lemah sebagai bukti umum.

blocks.title: Ide pokok vs penanda urutan
blocks.html: Penanda seperti Most importantly atau The strongest argument menunjukkan argumen yang paling diutamakan penulis. Ini sering ditanyakan.

Coding Should Be Taught in Every School

[Background + thesis] Not long ago, computer programming was seen as a specialized skill for engineers. Today, software shapes almost every part of daily life, from the apps we use to buy food to the systems that run hospitals and banks. In this world, coding should be taught in every school, not as an optional extra but as a basic subject.

[Argument 1] To begin with, coding develops problem-solving skills that are useful far beyond computers. Writing a program requires breaking a large problem into smaller steps, testing ideas, and finding mistakes. These habits of mind help students in mathematics, science, and even in planning their own projects.

[Argument 2] In addition, coding opens doors to a fast-growing job market. Many international reports have forecast strong demand for software developers and data specialists in the coming decade. Even in jobs that do not involve programming directly, people who understand how software works can communicate better with technical teams.

[Counterargument + rebuttal] It is true that many schools lack computers and trained teachers. However, coding can start without expensive equipment: "unplugged" activities with cards and puzzles teach the same logical thinking, and free online platforms allow teachers to learn alongside their students.

[Reiteration] In short, coding is the literacy of the digital age. Schools that teach it are not just preparing programmers; they are preparing citizens who can understand and shape the technology around them.

blocks.title: Soal hubungan argumen dan bukti
blocks.question: Which piece of evidence supports the second argument?
steps: Argumen kedua: coding membuka peluang kerja.
Bukti: Many international reports have forecast strong demand for software developers.
blocks.answer: Reports forecasting strong demand for software developers

blocks.title: Soal fungsi paragraf
blocks.question: What is the function of paragraph 4?
steps: Penulis mengakui kendala komputer dan guru, lalu menawarkan solusi.
blocks.answer: To acknowledge an obstacle and show how it can be overcome

blocks.title: Soal makna kiasan
blocks.question: What does the writer mean by coding is the literacy of the digital age?
steps: Literasi = kemampuan dasar membaca dan menulis yang wajib dimiliki semua orang.
Penulis menyamakan coding dengan kemampuan dasar di era digital.
blocks.answer: Coding is a basic skill everyone needs today, like reading and writing

blocks.question: Which statement would the writer most likely disagree with?

options.A: Coding can be introduced without many computers.
options.B: Coding should only be learned by future engineers.
options.D: Teachers can learn coding together with students.

blocks.explanation: Penulis menegaskan coding harus diajarkan di semua sekolah sebagai mata pelajaran dasar, bukan hanya untuk calon insinyur.

blocks.title: Klaim, alasan, bukti, keberatan, dan sanggahan
blocks.caption: Tentukan peran setiap kalimat dalam argumen Cities Need More Trees.

blocks.title: Strategi mengerjakan
blocks.html:
• Buat peta singkat: tesis → argumen 1, 2, 3 → keberatan → sanggahan → simpulan.
  • Untuk soal Which statement would the writer agree with?, cocokkan dengan tesis dan simpulan, bukan dengan pendapat pihak penentang.
  • Untuk makna kata, gunakan konteks dan imbuhan (dis-carded, out of reach).
  • Soal Why does the writer mention X? menanyakan fungsi X dalam argumen: contoh, bukti, konsesi, atau peringatan.

blocks.title: Jebakan yang sering muncul
blocks.html:
• Memilih argumen yang paling panjang dibahas sebagai yang paling penting, padahal penanda Most importantly ada di argumen lain.
  • Mengira kalimat konsesi adalah pendapat penulis.
  • Memilih pernyataan yang benar menurut pengetahuan umum tetapi tidak dibahas dalam teks.
Setelah memahami materi dan contoh di atas, kerjakan kuis bab ini. Teks Tingkat Lanjut lebih panjang dan argumentatif, jadi bacalah dengan teliti dan pelajari pembahasan setiap soal yang salah.
